verdict.rationale: Alloy is an AML, KYC and fraud platform, so gating externally submitted regulatory reports behind human approval is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents regulatory report filing or an approval step before submission. The pack mentions manual review events, investigations and auditable automation, but none of these is a documented approval gate on outbound regulatory reports.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can require an authorized human approval before an externally submitted regulatory report
